scope: Phase 0 — Baseline, Conformance, and Delivery Controls
Phase 1 — Identity, Authorization, and Trust Boundaries

finding.reason: The implementation history does not retain a failing behavioral test executed before production implementation.
finding.disposition: New tests are retrospective characterization and regression coverage only; they are not represented as historical TDD evidence.

remediation.testSynchronization: Phase 0-touched asynchronous tests use shared Vert.x futures, timers, and VertxTestContext facilities instead of Awaitility polling.
externalBoundaries: tenant isolation and privileged-read audit completion
agent-to-controller mutual TLS and server trust
controller-to-controller Raft mutual TLS and unknown-certificate rejection
runtime HTTP and Raft revocation on established TLS connections
HTTP, Raft, and agent old/new certificate overlap

retainedTddSlices.behavior: FTP and FTPS integration services are ready only after the mapped control port returns three consecutive FTP 220 responses.
retainedTddSlices.red: Two clean reactor runs failed when Docker health status timed out even though the mapped FTP or FTPS control port was accepting protocol connections.
retainedTddSlices.refactor: Removed redundant Docker health gating while retaining the stronger protocol-level readiness check and its diagnostic logging.

retainedTddSlices.behavior: Shared TLS test fixtures load from both module directories and the packaged core test JAR used by a full reactor build.
retainedTddSlices.red: The full reactor verification produced four FileSystemNotFoundException errors when controller security tests resolved jar: resources as filesystem paths.

retainedTddSlices.behavior: Runtime certificate revocation and trust-version updates apply to subsequent controller HTTP requests and Raft RPCs on existing TLS connections, with live authorization explanation, negative-boundary, expiry-observation, and configuration-change audit behavior.

observedFailures: PUT /api/v1/security/trust/revocations returned 404 before the route and handler existed.
RaftMtlsBoundaryIntegrationTest could not compile because CertificateTrustState did not exist.
The first wrong-role assertion targeted /api/v1/info, which legitimately allowed the SECURITY role; the test was corrected to the protected /api/v1/agents resource before the green run.
red.outcome: failed as expected before production implementation

retainedTddSlices.refactor: One atomic CertificateTrustState is shared by controller HTTP and Raft enforcement, with transport validation left at the TLS layer and lifecycle policy evaluated at each request or RPC.

retainedTddSlices.behavior: Existing security audit chains are verified before append, modified evidence causes startup refusal, and each event is durably written to distinct retained and operational chains.

observedFailures: Reopening a modified chain did not throw IllegalStateException.
red.outcome: modified-chain acceptance failed the assertion and dual-sink behavior was absent before production implementation

retainedTddSlices.refactor: Audit fan-out retains one event schema and writes the retained chain first; HashChainedAuditLog owns full-chain startup verification.

phase1Gate.basis: Representative live HTTP, Raft, and agent TLS boundaries plus the full clean seven-module regression build passed.
phase1Gate.notClaimed: Corporate-environment accreditation or enterprise production readiness
externalValidation: selected corporate PKI and enterprise gateway
production controller topology and agent estate
secrets platform and retained evidence collector

remainingGates: Formal approval or rejection of the initial Phase 0 and Phase 1 historical TDD process deviation
retained red-green-refactor evidence for every subsequent behavior-changing slice
